import data from "./data.json"
import {
  Page,
  Section,
  Group,
  Grid,
  Block,
  Text,
  Stat,
  DataTable,
  ProgressList,
  List,
  KV,
  FigureGrid,
  Figure,
  FigureImage,
  FigureLabel,
} from "@/components/report"

export default function Report() {
  const kpis = Object.fromEntries(data.kpis.map((k) => [k.key, k]))

  const contrastRows = data.contrast.map((c) => ({
    where: c.where,
    fg: c.fg,
    bg: c.bg,
    ratio: c.ratio,
    required: c.required,
    result: c.pass ? "达标" : "不达标",
  }))

  const confusionRows = data.confusions.map((c) => ({
    where: c.where,
    原界面: c.normal,
    红色盲: c["红色盲"],
    绿色盲: c["绿色盲"],
    蓝色盲: c["蓝色盲"],
    影响: c.affected.join("、"),
  }))
